debug.unique_summary: Unique monolith (no anchor) - offers all recipes with size <= N ({0}).
settings.draw_map_value_help:
Paints each monolith's best value (ex) on the large-map overlay, like
Radar's socket count (tinted by the threshold above). If it doesn't line
up with the monolith, match these to your Radar large-map settings:
settings.hide_map_values_panel_open: Hide map values while Combinations panel open
settings.highlight_locked_recipe_help: Gold border on the panel row of a sealed monolith's locked-in recipe.
settings.highlight_threshold_help:
Tints a monolith's header by its best reward value: green at/above the
threshold, yellow from 0.6x up to it, none below. 0 = off (use Price color).
settings.intro: RunecraftHelper: while the in-game Runeshape Combinations panel is open, the poe.ninja Exalted price is drawn on the right edge of each visible reward row. The reward name shown is the game's own (any client language).
settings.monolith_debug_help:
Pick a monolith and dump everything the offer rule uses (anchor/p/N,
sockets-vs-station N, area level, addresses, and every offered recipe with
row/size/gate/category/reward/levels/rune pattern). 'Copy report' -> clipboard
for reporting a game-vs-plugin mismatch.
settings.monolith_rewards_help:
For each nearby monolith: its anchor rune + hole, and the candidate
recipes (from Expedition2Recipes.dat, filtered by the anchor) with
poe.ninja Exalted prices. Reads the anchor off the persistent device,
so it works even out of the network bubble.
